name: refusal-e2e-unix-only-and-fixture-assumptions
body: The test is `#[cfg(unix)]` because of its dead-socket arm (precedent `dead_session_socket_makes_the_graph_unfresh`), so it is absent on non-unix targets; `database` and `git sha` are deliberately not flipped (both make `is_stale` false, so `refusal_message` returns `None`) and stay pinned by `no_db_is_never_stale`/`non_git_repo_is_never_stale`; the `authored digest` arm manufactures the divergence with a raw DB `Requirement` insert, leaving the tree-side recovery arm to `splice_e2e`. Upgrade if the repo gains a non-unix CI target or these fixture-shape assumptions change.
